The Retirement Home Killers.

By: ALTYDVRYSTAAT PRODUCTIONS | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Krugersdorp retirement home serial killers facing their third murder charge

Unique Selling Point:
Headliner news. New accused namely Maryna Vorster-Lin, will also be in the dock in connection to these murders.

Summary:
The retirement home killers.
Shaun Oosthuizen (39) and John duPlooy (27) from the Munsieville squattercamp outside Krugersdorp are facing their third murder charge for the death of a female resident of a retirement home. This time however, they will not be facing the court alone. Their fellow Munsieville resident, Maryna Vorster-Lin, will also be in the dock. They are accused of murdering Hetta Potgieter in the Macadamia retirement home in Mbombela on 8 July 2018.
Oosthuizen and Du Plooy have already been found guilty of the murders of two women. Their first victim was Engela van Wyk (86), whom they murdered on 24 June 2018 in her unit in the Rus-’n-bietjie-home in Springs.
A few weeks after Van Wyk’s murder, the two men (This time allegedly in the company of Vorster-Lin) allegedly struck again and Potgieter was murdered.
The three suspects were arrested and were released on bail.



Further information:
Maar dié keer sal Shaun Oosthuizen (39) en John du Plooy (27), wat bekend geword het as die Munsievillereeksmoordenaars, nie alleen in die beskuldigdebank staan nie: ’n Vroulike medebeskuldigde, Maryna Vorster-Lin, word saam met hulle beskuldig van die moord op Hetta Potgieter in die Macadamiaversorgingsoord in Mbombela op 8 Julie 2018. Oosthuizen en Du Plooy se eerste slagoffer was Engela van Wyk (86), wat op 24 Junie 2018 in haar wooneenheid in die Rus-’n-bietjie-tehuis in Springs oorval, beroof en verwurg is. Enkele weke later is Potgieter (85) op ’n soortgelyke wyse vermoor. Oosthuizen, Du Plooy en Vorster-Lin is ná dié moord aangekeer, maar op borgtog vrygelaat. On Spring day (1 September) the same year(2018) Oosthuizen and Du Plooy struck again, this time in Alberton. Barbara Fenton (85) was murdered in the Alberton Village retirement home in Alberton.
Since then the two men have been re-arrested and found guilty of the murders of Fenton and Van Wyk, receiving life sentences.
We want to interview a family member of each of the victims. The Fenton- and Van Wyk families should not be a problem, but Potgieter’s relatives have already told me they will wait for the trial to be completed before they talk to any media.
We also want to talk to the police officer who tied all three murders together, though that might be tricky.
On the other side we will go to Munsieville and try convince the families and/or friends of the accused to talk about them, their background and circumstance

Extra Budget Items:
Overnight in Nelspruit - possibly 2 x nights. Depending on outcome of court.

Budget to follow.

850 Km's x R3.50 = R2975

Accommodation - R790 pp per night x 2 = R3160

Press Release:


Nabbing the Retirement Home Killers
Motivated by money, two young men set out to con their way into retirement villages from the west of Johannesburg to Mbombela in Mpumalanga. In what might have appeared to be just a robbery gone wrong, they murdered two elderly women, were arrested, and while out on bail, killed another. It was such a simple modus operandi that they may have gotten away with many more attempts, were it not for the sharp detective work and collaboration between the community and police that finally put an end to their killing spree. Carte Blanche retraces the steps that put them back in the dock.
Director: Stenette Grosskopf | Journalist: Hendrik Hancke | Producer: Niel van Deventer


Script:


UPSOUND Elna: She baked the most wonderful cakes, bread,
V/O Elna Brand and her husband, Philip, have fond memories of her mother...
UPSOUND She made porridge, oh, like nobody else can - mieliepap.

Masa: Yes that’s why we love grandmothers.

Philip: Mogobe

Masa: Ah Mogobe, that’s the best!

V/O On the 24th of June 2018 their lives changed forever. 74-year old Engela van Wyk was murdered at the Rus ‘n Bietjie Old Age Home in Springs, where she lived.
Elna Brand I was just standing outside looking at the stars - it was nearly full moon - and said, Mama are you there? How can it be that you're not on the earth anymore, you know…
V/O Her mother’s brutal end haunts her.
Elna Brand There must have been a struggle. And they tied her up. Her hands were behind her back. And they also tied her feet and her knees and then they tied her to the bed.

V/O Although unknown at the time, the men responsible for the gruesome attack were Shaun Oosthuizen and John Duplooy. No one knows how they gained access to the old age home, or her unit… but there was no sign of forced entry...
Elna Brand Then they started going through the house, throwing everything out where they thought they could get money or jewelry. And her most precious rings was on her dressing table and that little bowl was lying right in front of her face on the floor.
And, um, that then they took those rings. And I knew that would have been devastating for her because she knew that was what I was going to inherit from her.

LINK While the Van Wyk family were still reeling from the shock of their beloved mother’s brutal murder, Sean Oosthuizen and Johny DuPlooy made their way to Mpumalanga.
Albert Voor hulle hiernatoe gekom het was hulle eers by ‘n ander ouetehuis wat ook nie baie ver is hiervanaf nie.
V/O After being denied entry, they moved on to the Macadamia Retirement Village and Care Centre in a quiet suburb of Mbombela.
Albert In Nelspruit Macadamia Oord het hulle ‘n inwoner oortuig dat hulle ‘n familielid binne die oord kom sien. En niewetend het die oom hulle ingelaat.
V/O An investigator from the NPO - Bossies Community Justice - Albert Greyvenstein - works closely with the police in the Mbombela area.
Albert Okay, kom ek gaan wys julle bietjie van nader...
V/O At about 10:37 on the morning of the 8th of July 2018, Oosthuizen and Du Plooy were seen driving past the entrance of Macadamia Village. With them in the car was a woman, who was later identified as Mandy Vorster -- Oosthuizen’s girlfriend at the time … and Du Plooy’s aunt.
Albert Jy kan sien, daarso is ‘n kamera daar en daar is kameras daar...
V/O That afternoon the body of 85-year old Hetta Potgieter was found in her apartment.
Francois Tannie Hetta het in die Frailcare gebly … en die enigste kameras wat hier rond was was hierdie kameras teen my gebou.
V/O CCTV footage from the cameras at Francois Theron’s Physiotherapy practice next door, caught a lot more than the initial drive-by scouting...
Albert Op die beeldmateriaal is die verdagtes gesien in ‘n voertuig waar hulle die nommerplaat van die voertuig afgehaal het en ‘n ander nommerplaat opgesit het.
Francois Die jongste ou het in die kar gesit, terwyl die man en die vrou het ingeloop. En toe na ‘n hele rukkie toe kom die vrou uit. Toe kom sit sy in die kar. En ek dink so 10min later, toe kom die man uit. Maar hy het hier by die hek uitgestap, so ‘n huppel in sy stap… vol bravade en gelukkig gelyk oor wat hy gedoen het.
V/O Greyvenstein and the police wasted no time and thanks to some clever detective work they were able to trace the vehicle.
Albert Greyvenstein Die registrasie wat hulle aanvanklik afgehaal het is nagegaan en ons het en ons het agtergekom dat daar ‘n opsporingssisteem in die voertuig is van twee of drie eienaars vantevore. Ons het daarin geslaag om die opsporingssisteem te heraktiveer en hulle gevolg tot in Krugersdorp.
V/O Within a week the three suspects were traced to a campsite in the Magaliesberg, about a half an hour from Krugersdorp.
Albert Greyvenstein Van daar af is hulle gearresteer by Lovers Rock - al drie van hulle - en hulle is teruggebring Nelsruit toe waar hulle in die hof verskyn het op aanklag van die moord op Tannie Hetta.
V/O They appeared in the Mbombela magistrates court and despite vehement objections by senior police investigators, Oosthuizen, Du Plooy and Vorster were released on R2000 bail each.
Albert Greyvenstein Col Stroh het in hulle borgaansoek herhaaldelik gesê dat sou hulle wel vrygelaat word hulle weer sal moord pleeg.
V/O This fear became a reality, when less than 2 weeks later, the retirement home killers struck again… on the East Rand.
V/O On Spring day 2018 the men got into another home in Alberton -- thinking on her feet, the 69-year old resident discovered one of the men had used the bathroom and drunk from her bottle of mouthwash... suspicious, she thwarted their plans by pretending to take an incoming phone call. The two fled....but Oosthuizen's DNA on the bottle gave him away… in trial this linked him to Alberton on the day in question.

Just hours later, 74-year old Barbara Fenton was attacked and murdered in her retirement unit around the corner at Alberton Village.
Jarred They rang the intercom system at the complex and they seem to use very common surnames like Van der Merwe, or Tannie Marie, and then claiming that they've come from wherever to inform the family member that someone has passed.

V/O Fenton’s granddaughter, Stacey Magid and her partner, Jarred Eve were notified of the incident the following day when her body was discovered. Fenton was savagely attacked.
Jarred She was severely bruised. She was bound with her hands. Uh oh. She was tied up by the hands and gagged.
V/O Desperate for answers, Eve contacted his stepfather, George Moraitis, a security expert who swiftly connected the dots.
George We knew who they were, we started following them … within 29 hours we had them behind bars…
Masa: Tell me about when you arrested them in Munsieville, what were they like?

When we did arrest them there was no emotion, there was no nothing, no feeling in his eyes.

Masa: George, you see all kinds of characters, you’ve touched on Shaun’s character… What kind of person is he and his accomplice?


Shaun, that is a cold killer. You can see it in his eyes, the way he walks and the way he talks… As for Johnny, his accomplice, I think Johnny was under Shaun’s spell.
V/O Although the men were now behind bars, the trauma for the three respective family members was far from over.
Jarred I think that year of in and out of the courts was probably just as hard as dealing with the incident itself. And because you continuously being reminded of it and as you being a you're getting all these new details is new, this new evidence, you then hear of not only the fact that these guys were previously charged for the same crime and were out on bail. But you see the list of the other crimes or charges that were against their names and you start to think to yourself how did this happen?
V/O In December 2019, Oosthuizen and Du Plooy were found guilty of the murder of Barbara Fenton, and in September last year they were also convincted for the murder of Engela van Wyk in Springs.
Elna Brand I'm glad they're in jail, not because I want revenge. It's because I want other people to be safe that’s still out there.

George Masa: How sure are we that this is not just a robbery gone wrong?
It proves it from all the other murders that they did. They followed the same sequence, the same story. Shaun knew what he was doing. I’m telling you now as we stand here, this is a killer. He killed them before he left. He didn’t want them to actually recognise them, that was the one part, and on a personal note I think he actually got a satisfaction out of it. He saw the fear in their eyes and he knew he was in control of them.
Albert Ek is seker daar was nog ander moorde ook gewees. Hierdie is nie die enigstes nie. Dit sal hopelik nog uitkom - dalk sal hulle dit nog herken….
V/O Earlier in January Oosthuizen and Duplooy - along with Mandy Vorster - briefly appeared in the Mpumalanga High Court for the Murder of Hetta Potgieter in Mbombela. The accused strongly opposed our cameras in court, but acting Judge Bruce Langa ruled that media coverage would be in the interest of the public. This trial is set to start on the 28th of July.
LINK It was here in Munsieville where the pair was finally nabbed and arrested. They were found in one of the shacks down this road.
V/O The infamous squatter camp lies on the outskirts of Johannesburg and we went looking for Mandy Vorster - who is still out on bail ...
Guy She’s not around. That’s her sister.

Masa: Whose sister is this?

Ja but don’t speak to her, she’s gonna go crazy.
V/O Vorster’s Sister, also Duplooy’s mother - who uses the name Judy Vorster on social media - was very unhappy to see us.
Judy Vorster Masa: Knock-knock, morning! Would you be able to talk to us?

Judy: Haven’t you had enough in court, hey? Didn’t you get enough in court of my son and my sister?

LINK She’s very very upset. She’s been shouting at us since we got here. And she just came out to basically tell us she doesn’t want to talk. And that’s it.
Judy Vorster Masa: We thought you’d like an opportunity to talk to us.

Judy: I said no comment. Are you deaf?
V/O Duplooy sister lives next door and briefly spoke to us off camera. She is adamant her brother is innocent and says she doesn't know Oosthuizen.
Sister Ek ken hom nie...
V/O From there on things escalated quickly. Members of the community started blowing whistles raising alarm, and instructing the kids to pick up stones.
UPSOUND We’re going… Kobus get in the car.
V/O And our visit to Munsieville ended abruptly.
UPSOUND Bye!
V/O Currently Oosthuizen and Du Plooy will be eligible for parole after serving 20 years, but a conviction in the Mbombela murder could add to that.
Albert Die derde een is half vir my ‘n formaliteit dat hulle ook gevonnis word daarso.
V/O With her mom’s killers behind bars, Brand can finally start to find healing and closure.
Elna I forgiven them for what I've done,

Masa: How

If you don't do that, these roots of bitterness in your heart, that will destroy you. It will not destroy them. They don't know how you feel about them. They don't care. But I’ve forgiven them and that has made me whole.

And because you continuously being reminded of it and as you being a you're getting all these new details is new, this new evidence, you then hear of not only the fact that these guys were previously charged for the same crime and were out on bail. But you see the list of the other crimes or charges that were against their names and you start to think to yourself how did this happen? V/O In December 2019, Oosthuizen and Du Plooy were found guilty of the murder of Barbara Fenton, and in September last year they were also convincted for the murder of Engela van Wyk in Springs. Elna Brand I'm glad they're in jail, not because I want revenge. It's because I want other people to be safe that’s still out there. George Masa: How sure are we that this is not just a robbery gone wrong? It proves it from all the other murders that they did. They followed the same sequence, the same story. Shaun knew what he was doing. I’m telling you now as we stand here, this is a killer. He killed them before he left. He didn’t want them to actually recognise them, that was the one part, and on a personal note I think he actually got a satisfaction out of it. He saw the fear in their eyes and he knew he was in control of them. Albert Ek is seker daar was nog ander moorde ook gewees. Hierdie is nie die enigstes nie. Dit sal hopelik nog uitkom - dalk sal hulle dit nog herken…. V/O Earlier in January Oosthuizen and Duplooy - along with Mandy Vorster - briefly appeared in the Mpumalanga High Court for the Murder of Hetta Potgieter in Mbombela. The accused strongly opposed our cameras in court, but acting Judge Bruce Langa ruled that media coverage would be in the interest of the public. This trial is set to start on the 28th of July. LINK It was here in Munsieville where the pair was finally nabbed and arrested. They were found in one of the shacks down this road. V/O The infamous squatter camp lies on the outskirts of Johannesburg and we went looking for Mandy Vorster - who is still out on bail ... Guy She’s not around. That’s her sister. Masa: Whose sister is this? Ja but don’t speak to her, she’s gonna go crazy. V/O Vorster’s Sister, also Duplooy’s mother - who uses the name Judy Vorster on social media - was very unhappy to see us. Judy Vorster Masa: Knock-knock, morning! Would you be able to talk to us? Judy: Haven’t you had enough in court, hey? Didn’t you get enough in court of my son and my sister? LINK She’s very very upset. She’s been shouting at us since we got here. And she just came out to basically tell us she doesn’t want to talk. And that’s it. Judy Vorster Masa: We thought you’d like an opportunity to talk to us. Judy: I said no comment. Are you deaf? V/O Duplooy sister lives next door and briefly spoke to us off camera. She is adamant her brother is innocent and says she doesn't know Oosthuizen. Sister Ek ken hom nie... V/O From there on things escalated quickly. Members of the community started blowing whistles raising alarm, and instructing the kids to pick up stones. UPSOUND We’re going… Kobus get in the car. V/O And our visit to Munsieville ended abruptly. UPSOUND Bye! V/O Currently Oosthuizen and Du Plooy will be eligible for parole after serving 20 years, but a conviction in the Mbombela murder could add to that. Albert Die derde een is half vir my ‘n formaliteit dat hulle ook gevonnis word daarso. V/O With her mom’s killers behind bars, Brand can finally start to find healing and closure. Elna I forgiven them for what I've done, Masa: How If you don't do that, these roots of bitterness in your heart, that will destroy you. It will not destroy them. They don't know how you feel about them. They don't care. But I’ve forgiven them and that has made me whole.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Krugersdorp retirement home serial killers facing their third murder charge
metadata.Unique Selling Point: Headliner news. New accused namely Maryna Vorster-Lin, will also be in the dock in connection to these murders.
metadata.Summary: The retirement home killers. Shaun Oosthuizen (39) and John duPlooy (27) from the Munsieville squattercamp outside Krugersdorp are facing their third murder charge for the death of a female resident of a retirement home. This time however, they will not be facing the court alone. Their fellow Munsieville resident, Maryna Vorster-Lin, will also be in the dock. They are accused of murdering Hetta Potgieter in the Macadamia retirement home in Mbombela on 8 July 2018. Oosthuizen and Du Plooy have already been found guilty of the murders of two women. Their first victim was Engela van Wyk (86), whom they murdered on 24 June 2018 in her unit in the Rus-’n-bietjie-home in Springs. A few weeks after Van Wyk’s murder, the two men (This time allegedly in the company of Vorster-Lin) allegedly struck again and Potgieter was murdered. The three suspects were arrested and were released on bail.
metadata.Further information: Maar dié keer sal Shaun Oosthuizen (39) en John du Plooy (27), wat bekend geword het as die Munsievillereeksmoordenaars, nie alleen in die beskuldigdebank staan nie: ’n Vroulike medebeskuldigde, Maryna Vorster-Lin, word saam met hulle beskuldig van die moord op Hetta Potgieter in die Macadamiaversorgingsoord in Mbombela op 8 Julie 2018. Oosthuizen en Du Plooy se eerste slagoffer was Engela van Wyk (86), wat op 24 Junie 2018 in haar wooneenheid in die Rus-’n-bietjie-tehuis in Springs oorval, beroof en verwurg is. Enkele weke later is Potgieter (85) op ’n soortgelyke wyse vermoor. Oosthuizen, Du Plooy en Vorster-Lin is ná dié moord aangekeer, maar op borgtog vrygelaat. On Spring day (1 September) the same year(2018) Oosthuizen and Du Plooy struck again, this time in Alberton. Barbara Fenton (85) was murdered in the Alberton Village retirement home in Alberton. Since then the two men have been re-arrested and found guilty of the murders of Fenton and Van Wyk, receiving life sentences. We want to interview a family member of each of the victims. The Fenton- and Van Wyk families should not be a problem, but Potgieter’s relatives have already told me they will wait for the trial to be completed before they talk to any media. We also want to talk to the police officer who tied all three murders together, though that might be tricky. On the other side we will go to Munsieville and try convince the families and/or friends of the accused to talk about them, their background and circumstance
